getting_started.title: Get Started
getting_started.description: Join our global community of changemakers creating happier cities through local action. Whether you're new or experienced, there's a path for everyone.

guides.title: Host Your First Gathering
guides.description: Learn how to organize a public happiness event in your community.

guides.title: Put Yourself on the Map
guides.description: So other Public Happiness creators can invite you to their gatherings and activities. Also your space to share links to photos and videos from them.

guides.title: Build Projects
guides.description: Contribute to global initiatives making the world a happier place.

gatherings.title: Gatherings (Local)
gatherings.description: Meet positive people nearby and join Public Happiness Gatherings - from music jams and free hugs to community connection events.

projects.title: Projects (Global)
projects.description: Collaborate on global initiatives that create positive change. Build tools, resources, and campaigns that spread happiness worldwide.

items.title: International Day of Happiness
items.description: Join millions worldwide celebrating the International Day of Happiness with gatherings, events, and acts of kindness in your community.

items.title: World Laughter Day
items.description: Celebrate the healing power of laughter with public laughter yoga sessions and joyful gatherings around the globe.

items.title: Global Free Hugs Day
items.description: Spread warmth and connection through the simple act of offering free hugs in public spaces worldwide.

projects.title: Ending Involuntary Homelessness
projects.description: A collaborative initiative to create sustainable solutions for homelessness through community action and innovative approaches.

projects.title: Climate Action
projects.description: Taking positive action on climate change through community gatherings, education, and grassroots initiatives.

projects.title: Road Trip
projects.description: Building the central hub and infrastructure for the Public Happiness Movement community.
